files.patch:
@@ -267,3 +267,7 @@ no-build-isolation-package = ["torch"]
 # openai-harmony alongside it silently overwrites those files, so keep it out
 # of every resolution; gpt-oss pulls it in transitively.
 exclude-dependencies = ["openai-harmony"]
+
+# do-not-merge: NIXL 1.5.0rc1.dev72182327 RC verification wheels.
+[tool.uv.pip]
+find-links = ["https://github.com/svc-networking-sw/nixl-ver/releases/download/1.5.0rc1.dev72182327/index.html"]

@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@ lmcache >= 0.3.9
 # CuPy 14.1.0 imports pytest from cupy.testing._random, which breaks runtime
 # images. 14.1.1 fixes the root cause, so only 14.1.0 is excluded.
 cupy-cuda13x != 14.1.0
-nixl == 1.5.0
+nixl == 1.5.0rc1.dev72182327 # do-not-merge: NIXL RC validation
 # CUDA 12 build. On the CUDA 13 image install-kv-connectors.sh swaps this for
 # the mooncake-transfer-engine-cuda13 variant of the same version.
 mooncake-transfer-engine >= 0.3.12

@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 # LMCache 0.5.x uses CUDA 13 dependencies; retain the CUDA 12 release here.
 lmcache == 0.4.4
 cupy-cuda12x != 14.1.0
-nixl == 1.4.1
+nixl == 1.5.0rc1.dev72182327 # do-not-merge: NIXL RC validation
 mooncake-transfer-engine >= 0.3.12
